html:
LEGO is a toy company founded in 1932 by the carpenter Ole Kirk Christiansen in the village of Billund, Jutland. It is now the largest toy maker in the world.

He began with wooden toys and named the firm from the Danish leg godt, play well. After the Second World War it began making plastic bricks, and in 1958 it patented the brick with tubes inside that locks firmly. That system of parts which all fit together made the company.

The firm is still controlled by the founder's family. It nearly failed in the early 2000s and recovered by cutting back and tying sets to films. Billund has its own airport and Legoland park, a sign of how far a small company in rural Denmark could reach. Like IKEA and Carlsberg, it is a Scandinavian family firm with a world brand.
sum: LEGO is a toy company founded in 1932 by the carpenter Ole Kirk Christiansen in the village of Billund, Jutland. It is now the largest toy maker in the world.
